v1.definition: A versioned index of organic results in the first 20 positions.
v1.interpretation: Read the index with observed coverage, fresh determinate counts, and comparable targets.
v1.limitation: This is not traffic or leads. Unknown results are not confirmed absence; changing coverage alone does not prove improvement.

qualified-v1.definition: The share of eligible determinate targets confirmed in the organic Top 10.
qualified-v1.interpretation: Read the rate alongside expected, measured, and ranked counts in the same scope.
qualified-v1.limitation: Unknown targets are not ranked or absent. The same percentage can describe different coverage; comparisons require a comparable cohort.

help-v1.definition: The confirmed position of an organic link on its declared rank scale.
help-v1.interpretation: Compare positions only within compatible search scope and methodology.
help-v1.limitation: A business slot, Maps listing, or feature presence is not an organic position. Unknown or absent results have no synthetic position.

help-v1.definition: Whether a search-results block was observed, such as Local Google results: businesses with a map in regular Google results.
help-v1.interpretation: A visible block and a confirmed target within that block are separate observations.
help-v1.limitation: No observed block, no confirmed business, unknown identity, and unsupported measurement mean different things.

help-v1.definition: Businesses with a map in regular Google results; a business slot refers to the explicitly confirmed branch.
help-v1.interpretation: The branch's stable identity and the original block, page, and slot identify the observation.
help-v1.limitation: A shared domain or similar name is only a candidate. Promoted or unknown promotion results are not organic-eligible; Maps and Local Finder use separate scales.

help-v1.definition: The confirmed listing position on the Google Maps surface, on its own rank scale.
help-v1.interpretation: Keep Maps observations separate from regular Google results and Local Finder.
help-v1.limitation: This explanation does not mean Maps measurement is available. Unsupported measurement is not a missing business or zero rank.

help-v1.definition: The confirmed listing position in Google's expanded local-results view, on its own scale.
help-v1.interpretation: Keep Local Finder observations separate from business slots in regular results and from Maps.
help-v1.limitation: This explanation does not enable Local Finder measurement. Unknown or unsupported observations do not prove absence.

help-v1.definition: Average position among targets with a confirmed positive rank in one compatible scope and rank scale.
help-v1.interpretation: Read ranked count and coverage alongside the average.
help-v1.limitation: Absent and unknown targets receive no zero or 101 position. Losing observations alone does not prove improvement.

help-v1.definition: When the search result was observed, not when the report or cache was read.
help-v1.interpretation: Requested time, recorded time, observation time, and report as-of time have different meanings.
help-v1.limitation: Reading a cached result does not create a new observation or make old data fresh. Missing historical timestamps stay unknown.

help-v1.definition: Observed coverage describes determinate retained observations; fresh coverage additionally requires an explicit freshness policy.
help-v1.interpretation: Read expected, observed, fresh determinate, unknown, and comparable counts separately. Comparable count describes paired targets, not coverage.
help-v1.limitation: Unknown freshness is not fresh. A failed attempt can coexist with a retained successful observation; quality counts are not necessarily disjoint.

help-v1.definition: A change between observations with compatible scope, methodology, identity, and evidence.
help-v1.interpretation: Read the paired comparable count and original observation dates. Percentage-point change differs from relative percent change.
help-v1.limitation: Missing baseline, changed scope, entry, exit, or re-entry is not an ordinary numeric movement. A change in membership alone does not prove improvement.

help-v1.definition: The observed URL is the page actually found in that observation; the desired URL is the configured target.
help-v1.interpretation: Use each historical check's observed URL when reading its result.
help-v1.limitation: Today's URL or the desired URL cannot fill a missing historical observed URL. Missing evidence remains unavailable.

help-v1.definition: An estimate before execution is distinct from confirmed provider usage or cost after settlement.
help-v1.interpretation: Read amounts in their native unit. Provider cost, customer charge, and application credits are separate measures.
help-v1.limitation: Search quota is not USD. An unknown charge is not zero; a cached read is not a new paid request. Help does not fetch current prices or run checks.

help-v1.definition: The requested result horizon is distinct from the horizon proven complete by the observation.
help-v1.interpretation: Interpret a missing target using the observed scope, result kind, rank scale, and completeness evidence.
help-v1.limitation: Requested depth alone does not prove absence. Unknown completeness remains unknown; organic completeness does not prove local-block completeness.

help-v1.definition: Where the search is simulated; this is different from the business address or branch identity.
help-v1.interpretation: Read the configured and effective search scope when a provider substitutes a location.
help-v1.limitation: One city observation does not cover every point in that city. A country fallback is not evidence for the requested city.

help-v1.definition: The schedule requests new observations; refreshing the view reads stored report data.
help-v1.interpretation: Read the original observation time and explicit freshness policy independently of when the view was refreshed.
help-v1.limitation: Opening help or reading a widget does not launch a provider check, change the schedule, or turn a cached observation into a new one.

visibility-top20-v1.definition: A versioned index of organic results in the first 20 positions.
visibility-top20-v1.interpretation: Read the index with observed coverage, fresh determinate counts, and comparable targets.
visibility-top20-v1.limitation: This is not traffic or leads. Unknown results are not confirmed absence; changing coverage alone does not prove improvement.

bisibility-sov-top10-v2.definition: The selected domain’s share of volume-weighted linear Top 10 scores across the selected domains.
bisibility-sov-top10-v2.interpretation: All domains use the same qualified keyword cohort and weights. Read the observed coverage and fresh coverage alongside the percentage.
bisibility-sov-top10-v2.limitation: This is a relative index of selected domains, not market share, traffic or leads. Unknown and stale observations are excluded; zero total scores produce no percentage. Version 2 changes the legacy treatment of missing volumes and incomplete observations.

Missed complete intervals are skipped; unknown accepted work prevents repurchase. Issued quotes count conservatively against the total ceiling, even if no task is sent.
